participant_1.name: Mike
participant_1.personality: Caring and introspective, Mike enjoys music production but carries the weight of past relationships.
participant_1.background: My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. I prefer being inside. I'm a 46-year-old single dad with kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year.

participant_2.name: Sarah
participant_2.personality: Friendly and open-minded, Sarah enjoys sharing meals and spending time with her children.
participant_2.background: I like to eat hamburgers and french fries. I don't drink soda. I live in a house. I like to take walks. I am a single mom of two years and I love to cook.
